proposals.title: Proposal 6
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Citigroup prepare a report by September 2016 demonstrating the company does not have a gender pay gap.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this Proposal 6

proposals.title: Proposal 7
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report disclosing Citigroup's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, and board oversight of lobbying and grassroots communications.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this Proposal 7

proposals.title: Proposal 8
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to appoint an independent committee to evaluate whether divesting all non-core banking segments would enhance shareholder value and publicly report.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST Proposal 8

proposals.title: Proposal 9 – Clawback Amendment
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend the clawback policy so executive pay is deferred up to 10 years and forfeitable to help satisfy monetary penalties for legal violations.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 9

proposals.title: Proposal 10
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy prohibiting vesting of equity awards for senior executives who voluntarily resign to enter government service.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 10
